story.text: 승객 여러분, 아시아 최고의 영화 축제가 열리는 영화의 전당 상공을 지나고 있습니다!
story.reading: seung-gaek yeo-reo-bun, a-si-a choe-go-ui yeong-hwa chuk-je-ga yeol-li-neun yeong-hwa-ui jeon-dang sang-gong-eul ji-na-go iss-seum-ni-da!
story.en: Passengers, we're passing over the Busan Cinema Center, home to Asia's greatest film festival!

story.text: 올해 영화제의 '개막작'이 무엇인지 벌써부터 화제예요. 첫 상영작이라 의미가 크죠.
story.reading: ol-hae yeong-hwa-je-ui gae-mak-jag-i mu-eos-in-ji beol-sseo-bu-teo hwa-je-ye-yo.
story.en: What this year's 'opening film' will be is already a hot topic. Being the first screening, it carries great meaning.

story.text: '레드카펫'에는 유명 배우들이 화려한 옷을 입고 등장해서 정말 볼거리예요.
story.reading: re-deu-ka-pes-e-neun yu-myeong bae-u-deul-i hwa-ryeo-han os-eul ip-go deung-jang-hae-seo jeong-mal bol-geo-ri-ye-yo.
story.en: On the 'red carpet', famous actors appear in glamorous outfits, and it's truly a sight to see.

story.text: 부산 곳곳의 '상영관'에서 세계 여러 나라의 영화를 만나볼 수 있어요.
story.reading: bu-san got-got-ui sang-yeong-gwan-e-seo se-gye yeo-reo na-ra-ui yeong-hwa-reul man-na-bol su iss-eo-yo.
story.en: At 'screening venues' all across Busan, you can experience films from many countries around the world.

story.text: 인기 있는 영화는 순식간에 매진되니, '예매'는 서두르는 게 좋아요.
story.reading: in-gi iss-neun yeong-hwa-neun sun-sik-gan-e mae-jin-doe-ni, ye-mae-neun seo-du-reu-neun ge jo-a-yo.
story.en: Popular films sell out in an instant, so it's best to hurry with 'advance booking'.

story.text: 상영이 끝나면 '관객'들이 큰 박수와 함께 감독에게 질문을 던지기도 해요.
story.reading: sang-yeong-i kkeut-na-myeon gwan-gaek-deul-i keun bak-su-wa ham-kke gam-dok-e-ge jil-mun-eul deon-ji-gi-do hae-yo.
story.en: When the screening ends, the 'audience' gives a big round of applause and sometimes asks the director questions.

story.text: 단어는 다 익히셨죠? 이번엔 영화제 현장의 실제 대화를 보고 상황을 맞혀보는 문제도 준비했어요!
story.en: Got all the words down? This time I've also prepared questions where you read real conversations from the festival grounds and figure out the situation!

words.example: 개막작은 영화제의 첫 상영작으로 큰 주목을 받습니다.
words.example_reading: gae-mak-jag-eun yeong-hwa-je-ui cheot sang-yeong-jag-eu-ro keun ju-mog-eul bad-seum-ni-da
words.example_en: The opening film, as the festival's first screening, receives a great deal of attention.
Famous actors appear glamorously on the red carpet.
A film from a different country is screened at each venue.

words.example: 예매를 미리 하지 않으면 인기 있는 영화는 보기 힘들어요.
words.example_reading: ye-mae-reul mi-ri ha-ji anh-eu-myeon in-gi iss-neun yeong-hwa-neun bo-gi him-deul-eo-yo
words.example_en: If you don't book in advance, it's hard to watch a popular film.

words.example: 관객들은 영화가 끝난 후 큰 박수를 보냅니다.
words.example_reading: gwan-gaek-deul-eun yeong-hwa-ga kkeut-nan hu keun bak-su-reul bo-naem-ni-da
words.example_en: The audience gives a big round of applause after the film ends.

sentences.ko: 개막작은 영화제의 첫 상영작으로 큰 주목을 받습니다.
sentences.reading: gae-mak-jag-eun yeong-hwa-je-ui cheot sang-yeong-jag-eu-ro keun ju-mog-eul bad-seum-ni-da
sentences.en: The opening film, as the festival's first screening, receives a great deal of attention.
Famous actors appear glamorously on the red carpet.
A film from a different country is screened at each venue.

sentences.ko: 예매를 미리 하지 않으면 인기 있는 영화는 보기 힘들어요.
sentences.reading: ye-mae-reul mi-ri ha-ji anh-eu-myeon in-gi iss-neun yeong-hwa-neun bo-gi him-deul-eo-yo
sentences.en: If you don't book in advance, it's hard to watch a popular film.

sentences.ko: 관객들은 영화가 끝난 후 큰 박수를 보냅니다.
sentences.reading: gwan-gaek-deul-eun yeong-hwa-ga kkeut-nan hu keun bak-su-reul bo-naem-ni-da
sentences.en: The audience gives a big round of applause after the film ends.

turns.speaker: 관광객
turns.text: 이 영화 예매하고 싶은데, 아직 자리가 남아 있나요?
turns.reading: i yeong-hwa ye-mae-ha-go sip-eun-de, a-jik ja-ri-ga nam-a iss-na-yo?
turns.en: I'd like to book this film — are there still seats left?

turns.speaker: 매표소 직원
turns.text: 네, 저녁 7시 상영관에 몇 자리 남아 있어요.
turns.reading: ne, jeo-nyeok il-gop-si sang-yeong-gwan-e myeot ja-ri nam-a iss-eo-yo.
turns.en: Yes, there are a few seats left for the 7 PM screening.

turns.speaker: 관광객
turns.text: 그럼 두 자리 예매할게요. 상영관은 어디예요?
turns.reading: geu-reom du ja-ri ye-mae-hal-ge-yo. sang-yeong-gwan-eun eo-di-ye-yo?
turns.en: Then I'll book two seats. Where is the venue?

turns.speaker: 매표소 직원
turns.text: 영화의 전당 3관이에요, 개막작이라 사람이 많을 거예요.
turns.reading: yeong-hwa-ui jeon-dang sam-gwan-i-e-yo, gae-mak-jag-i-ra sa-ram-i man-heul geo-ye-yo.
turns.en: It's Theater 3 at the Busan Cinema Center — it's the opening film, so it'll be crowded.

dialogues.question: 관광객이 예매하려는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What is the tourist trying to book?
dialogues.explanation: 관광객이 '두 자리 예매할게요'라고 말했고 직원이 안내한 시간은 저녁 7시이므로, 저녁 7시 영화표 두 장을 예매하려는 것입니다.

turns.speaker: 관객A
turns.text: 저기 레드카펫에 배우들 들어오는 거 보여?
turns.reading: jeo-gi re-deu-ka-pes-e bae-u-deul deul-eo-o-neun geo bo-yeo?
turns.en: Can you see the actors coming in on the red carpet over there?

turns.speaker: 관객B
turns.text: 어, 사람이 너무 많아서 잘 안 보여. 조금만 앞으로 가자.
turns.reading: eo, sa-ram-i neo-mu man-h-a-seo jal an bo-yeo. jo-geum-man ap-eu-ro ga-ja.
turns.en: Yeah, there are too many people so I can't see well. Let's move up a bit.

turns.speaker: 관객A
turns.en: By the way, do you know what today's opening film is?

turns.speaker: 관객B
turns.text: 응, 올해는 한국 감독의 신작이 개막작이래.
turns.reading: eung, ol-hae-neun han-guk gam-dog-ui sin-jag-i gae-mak-jag-i-rae.
turns.en: Yeah, apparently this year's opening film is a new work by a Korean director.

dialogues.question: 두 사람이 지금 하고 있는 것은 무엇인가요?
dialogues.question_en: What are the two people currently doing?
dialogues.explanation: 두 사람이 레드카펫으로 들어오는 배우들을 보려 하고 있으므로 배우들을 구경하는 중임을 알 수 있습니다.
